read_policy: Files hashed as inert bytes only. Target source not imported or executed. Candidate semantics reused from saved source/review memory.

active_requirements.shared_core: Persistent shared NCN encoder and dense predictor basis.
active_requirements.private_state: Four private factor/LayerNorm/beta rows and separate carried Adam histories; not four full predictors.
active_requirements.endpoint_rule: Union of BOTH positive and negative outer query endpoints; inner positive and negative pairs exclude every endpoint in that current union. Support retains other endpoint context and masks the union of target positives.
active_requirements.update_order: Virtual private Adam from old private state; outer derivative into shared blocks; actual shared Adam update; recompute private gradients from unchanged old private state/moments at new shared blocks; commit inner-only private update and discard virtual moments.
active_requirements.deployment: Serve committed private states by mean raw logits, without inference adaptation.
active_requirements.objective: Half pooled BCE plus half mean member BCE.

scope_limits: No model, optimizer, metric or numerical execution.
